authority: Shawn Vibert directives, 2026-10-23 (structure, Smart Note language law, delivery + presentation)

both_required: the report itself in chat (nutshell + lists, Smart Note language)
delivery.link_rule: a link is a claim of completion — share it only after opening the room and seeing today's report render; before that, chat carries the report and states plainly the room page is being published

feature.output: the same truth re-issued as NUTSHELL + HUMAN + CHILD + GRANDMA versions; facts, numbers and links preserved
feature.scope: reports are born in Smart Note language; all other outputs convert on request
feature.trigger_phrase: send it in Smart Note language

language_law.name: Smart Note language
rules: plain words first; short sentences, one idea each
no unexplained jargon; a necessary technical term is explained in everyday words in the same sentence
every item states what it means for a person
grandma test before shipping; failure means rewrite

presentation_rule: The Reports room's existing format governs (one raised card per report: CANONICAL tag, date, title, one-line arc, word/section counts, READ THE REPORT inline render, MD download, COPY LINK). Never design a new page for a report; never send a homemade rendition as the deliverable; open the existing surface and match it.

publish.first_run_receipt: 2026-10-23: report filed on main via PR #3007 (merged 15:27Z); room verified live holding 26 daily reports through 2026-10-22; the 2026-10-23 card was the owed publish step
steps: ask the sync lane to publish it into the room, in the room's own format
author opens the room and today's report and observes it render — only then it is published

skeleton_in_order: header (date, window, main tip, one-line arc, 'Written in Smart Note language')
THE DAY IN NUMBERS (<=7, translated into meaning, vs yesterday)
TOP 10 LESSONS LEARNED (each with a declared behavior change)
THE BOARD AHEAD (<=7, owner + next move)
DECISIONS FOR SHAWN (true gates only, <=5, recommendation each)
timing: day edition closes the UTC day; a mid-day edition labels its window honestly and is extended, never silently replaced, by the close
title: Daily Intelligence Report — write it, file it, publish it, verify it, deliver it
